title: Workspace
acceptDescription: Invite token detected in the URL.
createOrgDescription: Hotel/company workspace (not personal). You become owner.
noOrgYet: No organization yet. Create a workspace or wait until workspace APIs are live.
membersUnavailable: Members are not available yet (workspace API may not be live).
inviteDescription: Role: admin, member, or viewer (not owner).
invitesUnavailable: Invite list is not available yet.
noPendingInvitesHint: Use the form above to invite an admin, member, or viewer.
inviteLinkHint: Share this link with the invitee. They must sign in with the same email.
pilotDescription: Scan attach for one org. Credits stay personal. Guard and SIEM are separate SKUs — do not bundle.
pilotStepOrg: Confirm this workspace is the hotel or company (one org, not nested properties).
pilotStepInvite: Invite IT as owner/admin and GM as viewer if they only need reports.
pilotStepAssets: Name 1–3 assets (Basic/Pro). Multi-10 only after renew works.
pilotStepSchedules: Enable a schedule (monthly Basic, weekly Pro+). Notify on new critical/high.
pilotStepCredits: Top up personal credits so the schedule does not auto-disable.
pilotStepReport: Send the Bahasa executive HTML. Hybrid review is 5 business days, not 24/7 SOC.
